source_note: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位，Fejer核是逼近单位元
english_source_note: Dirichlet Kernels Fail, Fejer Kernels Approximate Identity
callout_id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#6
statement_en: Assume $f \in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$, and the series of its Fourier coefficients converges absolutely, that is, $$\sum_{n\in \mathbb{Z}}|\widehat{f}(n)|<\infty.$$ Then the partial sums of the Fourier series of $f$ converge uniformly to $f$ itself.
callout_body: 假设$f \in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$，并且其对应的傅里叶系数形成的级数绝对收敛，即$$\sum_{n\in \mathbb{Z}}|\widehat{f}(n)|<\infty$$那么函数的傅里叶级数的部分和一致收敛到函数本身。
